name: ENG1 or 2 FIRE
description: Overtemperature detected in the engine compartment. Voice message "FIRE, ENGINE ONE/TWO FIRE".

procedure.heading: On ground:
procedure.text:
1. EMER OFF sw (affected engine) — Raise guard, press and release
2. Both FUEL PRIME PUMP sw's — Check OFF
3. Both ENG MAIN sw's — OFF
4. Passengers — Alert / evacuate
5. BAT MSTR sw — OFF

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text:
1. OEI flight condition — Establish
2. EMER OFF sw (affected engine) — Raise guard, press and release
3. VMS page — Select
4. Affected engine — Identify
5. Single engine emergency shutdown — Perform

procedure.heading: If ENG FIRE warning is off after shutdown:

procedure.text: If ENG FIRE warning remains on: LAND IMMEDIATELY. Alert / evacuate passengers.
Pressing EMER OFF automatically shuts down the affected engine (ACTIVE illuminates, FUEL VALVE CLSD caution appears). The extinguisher bottle (if installed) automatically discharges when N1 < 50%.

references: FLM EC135 T3H Sect. 3.9.1 (Helionix Step 3.5, 3 MFD)
